content: Local-first pitfalls: external sync services (OneDrive/Dropbox/Obsidian Sync) can revert freshly-written files within seconds — silent data loss unless writes are verified after write; multiple sync layers on same dir cause corruption; last-modified-wins destroys concurrent edits. Atomic write (temp+rename+fsync) plus post-write verification and sync-dir detection are the mitigations. Schema evolution needs versioned migrations from day one, plus export path independent of app.
